name: hive-monorepo
description: Self-hosted AI infrastructure: IAM, HiveMem memory service, model router, and the unified Hive console.
author: ChefTaco

scripts.bootstrap: for d in services/hive-router services/hive-iam services/hive-mem/ts-core services/hive-skills packages/hive; do (cd "$d" && npm ci) || exit 1; done && npm run hooks:install
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:router && npm run typecheck:iam && npm run typecheck:memory-ts && npm run typecheck:skills && npm run typecheck:launcher
scripts.build: npm run build:router && npm run build:iam && npm run build:memory-ts && npm run build:skills && npm run build:launcher
scripts.test: npm run test:router && npm run test:iam && npm run test:audit && npm run check:openapi && npm run test:memory-ts && npm run test:skills && npm run test:release-manager && npm run test:launcher
scripts.test:audit: node --experimental-strip-types --test scripts/audit-deployments.test.ts scripts/service-manifest.test.ts scripts/hive-doctor.test.ts scripts/hive-backup.test.ts scripts/dev-hive.test.ts scripts/hive-deploy.test.ts scripts/hivemem-token.test.ts scripts/architecture-boundaries.test.ts scripts/release-config-hardening.test.ts
scripts.audit:production: npm --prefix services/hive-router audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high && npm --prefix services/hive-iam audit --workspace @hivemagnus/hive-iam-server --omit=dev --audit-level=high && npm --prefix services/hive-iam/apps/iam-core audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high && npm --prefix services/hive-iam audit --workspace @hivemagnus/hive-iam-sdk --omit=dev --audit-level=high && npm --prefix services/hive-mem/ts-core audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high && npm --prefix services/hive-skills audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high && npm --prefix packages/hive audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high
scripts.scripts:check: bash -n scripts/*.sh services/hive-iam/scripts/*.sh services/hive-iam/apps/iam-core/scripts/*.sh services/hive-mem/scripts/*.sh services/hive-router/scripts/*.sh services/hive-skills/scripts/*.sh
scripts.test:webhook-sdks: npm run build:memory-ts && npm --prefix services/hive-mem/sdks/typescript run build && node --test scripts/hivemem-webhook-sdk.test.mjs
